decisions.evidence: The main limitation is that the generator cannot reliably reason across multiple retrieved facts.
Retrieval helps questions with a single supporting passage, but contradictory passages reduce accuracy on synthesis questions.
A contradiction-aware preprocessing step flags passages that disagree on numbers or negation, but it does not resolve them.
The paper does not specifically address rare conditions or mention improvements in handling them.
The paper does not mention any changes to the hardware requirements of CuraLM-70B.
The paper does not address deployment costs or provide evidence of reduced expenses.
